content: Baibitar Nah 10 Biyah Numin
“Nati ana veya’amaim mar ana aiwob itinin i boro baibitar nah ten biyah numin tabin boubun itinamih hai ramef hibow hinan na’atube.
Baibitar five i not wairafih, naatu baibitar five i men not wairafih.
Baibitar men not wairafih hai ramef hibow, baise karisin men ta hirirabar hibaimih.
Baibitar five not wairafih hai ramef hibow naatu kibubumaim karisin hirirbaren hibow auman hin.
Tabin boubun ana orot men saise na, baibitar isan hima hikakaif matah fot hi’inurir hi’in.”
“Fainaiwan sabuw fanah sibisib hinowar, ‘Tabin boubun ana orot enan kwana kwa’itin.’”
“Imaibo baibitar ten hi’inu’in himisir, hai ramef matah hibobaituturen naatu hito’aben.
Baibitar men not wairafih turahinah not wairafih isah hio, ‘A karisin turin kwaibaisi, aki ai ramef temomorob.’”
“Baise baibitar five not wairafih hiyafutih hio, ‘Men karam boro kwa turin anit naatu aki turin anab. Gewasin boro kwanan sabuw biyahimaim kwabo isa kwanatobon.’”
“Basit baibitar karisin tobonamih hinan ufut, tabin boubun ana orot natit, baibitar five hibobuna hima’am bairi hin tabin ana yasisir wanawanan hirun etawan hitufabon.”
“Men manin baibitar five hina hitit hi’afririy ‘Regah, Regah, etawan kubotawiy arun!’”
“Baise orot efatait eo, ‘Anababatun a tur ao’owen, ayu men aso’ob kwa iyab.’”
“Isan imih mata to niwa’an kwanama, anayabin veya o sumar men kwa so’ob, mar biy boro iti sawar hinamatar.”
Akir Wairafin Tounu
“Maramaim mar ana aiwob itinin ta i iti na’atube. Orot ef yok bainanawan isan bobobunabuna ana veya; ana akir wairafih e’afih hina ana sawar kaifen isan faramih.
Hai so’ob ana fofoninamaim orot ta ana kabay 5,000 itin, orot ta 2,000, orot ta 1,000. Imaibo i ana nanawan busuruf in.
Akir wairafin 5,000 baib in banikamaim yari’iy in bowabow, 5,000 tafan hiya’abar bai.
Akir wairafin bairou’abin i na’atube sinaf. Kabay 2,000 bai in imaim ma bikukumiyaw 2,000 tafan hiya’abar bai.
Baise akir wairafin ta ana kabay 1,000 baib i mutufor in hub bai regah ana kabay hub iwan taunafut in.
“Hima manin maiyow, imaibo akir wairafih hai orot ukwarin matabir na tit, naatu hai bowabow nuteteyan itah.
Naatu akir wairafin kabay 5,000 baib na run ana regah nanamaim eo, ‘Regah o 5,000 itu, baise ayu abowabow tafanamaim 5,000 abaib i iti kubai.’”

“Regah iya’afut eo, ‘A merar ayiy, o i bowayan orot gewas naatu bosunusunubayan, bowabow gidigidih ibosunusunub kukakaifen gewas, imih boro anayara’ahi inayen sawar gagamih inakaifen. Kuna kurun au yasisir turin kubai!’
“Naatu akir wairafin bairou’abin kabay 2,000 baib na run eo, ‘Regah o a kabay 2,000 ibitu i iti, naatu abowabow tafanamaim 2,000 abaib i iti kubai.’

“Regah eo, ‘A merar ayiyi, o i bowayan orot gewas naatu bosunusunubayan, sawar matan ta ibosunusunub kukakaifen gewas. Imih boro anayara’ahi inayen sawar moumurihika inakaifen. Kuna kurun au yasisir turin kubai.’
“Imaibo akir wairafin baitonin kabay 1,000 baib na run eo, ‘Regah ayu aso’ob, o i a tur fokarin, turanah hai masaw o aribe kufafaur naatu turanah nowah o kutatanumabe kutaratar.
Imih ayu o isa abir. A kabay abai an hub agais aibun inu’in, iti abai ana abit maiye kwitin.’
“Ana Regah iya’afut eo, ‘O i orot kakaf nokonokow anababatun! O iso’ob, ayu i tebob nonowatih afafour naatu tetatanum nonowatih ataratar.
Gewasin au kabay banikamaim itayi ta’in tabowabow, ayu atanan, saise tafan hitaya’abar auman hitutu atab.’
“Naatu orot ukwarin eo, ‘Kabay iti orot umanamaim kwabosair kwabai kwan akir wairafin kabay 10,000 baib i kwaitin.
Anayabin orot yait uman ebi’e’etaw boro sawar tafan hinaya’abar moumurihika nabow isan nakaram. Baise orot yait uman nutanub ema’am biyanamaim sawar etei’imak boro hinabosairen.
Imih iti akir wairafin nukunukuwin kwabai kwan kwarauw ufun gugumin wanawanan ere, nati imaim nama narerey wan nayob nitafofofor.’
Baibatebat Gagamin
“Orot Natun ni’aiwob nanan ana maramaim ana tounamatar kakafiyih boro bairi hinan ana urama’am bonamanamarin tafan namare.
Naatu tafaram wanawanan sabuw tutufin etei boro hinaru’ay Jesu nanamaim hinabat. Imaibo i boro sabuw nakusib rou’ab hinamatar, nabatanenayan sheep naatu goat bairi ekukusibih na’atube.
Sheep i boro uman ana asukwafune hinabat naatu goat boro uman ana beyawane hinabat.”
“Imaibo aiwob orot boro sabuw uman ana asukwafune isah nao, ‘Kwa i Tamai ebigegewasini, kwana mar ana aiwob nowamih kwabai. Anayabin tafaram matara’e ana veya God kwa isa yabuna.
Ayu bayumih amomorob bay kwaitu, sikau mamamah harew kwaitu atom, abinanawan au merar kwayi a baremaim ama ra’at ama.
Segar ama’am faifuw kwaitu aus, asawow ainu’in, kwakaifu naatu dibur bar ama’am kwana kwainanawanu.’”
“Sabuw gewasih boro hiniya’afut hinao, ‘Regah mar biyika bayumih imomorob ai’it bay ait, o sika mamamah harew ait itom?
Naatu biyika inanawan inan ai’it a merar ayiy abuwi ai sebomaim imara’at? O segar ima’am faifuw ait ius?
Naatu mar biyika isawow inu’in akaifi, o dibur bar ima’ama ainanawani?’”
“Aiwob orot boro niyafutih nao, ‘Anababatun au’uwi, nati ana veya’amaim ayu taitu gidigidih isah kwasisinaf, i ayu isau kwasinaf.’”

“Imaibo sabuw ana beyawane hinabatabat isah boro nao, ‘Biyau’umaim kwatit sa’ab kwan. Kwa i orarafen wanawanan kwarun, Demon Mowan ana tounamatar bairi isah wairaf wanatowan hibobogaigiwas kwan imaim kwarun bairi e’arahi.
Ayu aa amomorob, men abisa ta kwaitu aan, sikau mamamah harew men kwaitu atom.
Ai nanawan anan men au merar kwayi a sebomaim amara’at. Segar ama’am faifuw men kwaitu ausimih, a sawow ainu’in, o dibur baremaim ama’am men kwana kwainanawanu.’”
“Naatu i boro hiniya’afut hinao, ‘Regah, mar biyika o aa imomorob, o harewamih sika mamamah, o ibinanawan, o segar ima’am, o isawow inu’in, o dibur bar ima’am men aibaisimih?’”
“Imaibo i boro niyafutih nao, ‘Anababatun a tur ao’owen, ayu taitu gidigidih men kwabibaisih, nati i men kwakok ayu kwatibaisu.’”
“Naatu nati sabuw i boro hinan ma’ama wanatowan ana baimakiy hinab. Baise sabuw gewasih boro hinan yawas ma’ama wanatowan hinab hinama hiniyasisir.”
